blocks.html: Robinsons Land’s RLove, a corporate social responsibility program initiated by its employees, is actively participating in the Department of Education’s Brigada Eskwela project with over 25,000 public school students benefitting from this partnership. The team visited public schools located in Quezon City, Pasig, Rizal, Pangasinan, Tarlac, Cavite , Batangas and Roxas. To date, RLove is involved in upgrading several public school classrooms located in 8 different sites. Upgrades include repainting of classrooms, & construction of hand-wash areas. Robinsons Land’s employees are acting as volunteers, lending their free time during the weekends to assist not only in repainting the classrooms but also cleaning the classrooms. RLove also donated cleaning materials, and paints, fixtures like book shelves. When asked why they participated in RLove Brigada Eskwela, Robinsons Land’s employee volunteers were unanimous in saying that it’s a most full filling experience to help those in need and worthy to know that their co-employees share this noble sentiment.
